content.text: Submitted. The repaired insertion (new Section 10.3 after p0042) now states the preferred position in full: up to six (6) months' transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, return of all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination (the clock no longer runs from a Customer request), and deletion with written certification thereafter. The duplicative backup/legal-retention carve-out was dropped as already covered by Section 16.5.
